cohort: The study cohort consisted of 195 postdated and post term pregnant patients who delivered at C.U. Shah medical college over a one-year period.
finding: Postdated and post term pregnancies were associated with increased chances of instrumental delivery, failure of induction, caesarean section, and neonatal NICU admission with adverse outcomes.
mod_finding: The study found increased chances of instrumental delivery and caesarean section in postdated and post term pregnancies.
gest_age: Postdated pregnancy (beyond 40+0 weeks), Post term pregnancy
